items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Sondernutzungserlaubnis
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, an das Bezirksamt Musterwerder, Wasserturmweg 3, 22089 Hamburg zu richten, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday), sent by ordinary mail. Per § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG (quoted on page 2) it is deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 19.11. + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Monday) - not a weekend/holiday, so no shift. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of notification (23.11.2026) itself is not counted; the one-month Widerspruchsfrist begins 24.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering (notification) day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday) - a regular business day in Hamburg (the Christmas public holidays are 25./26.12, not relevant), so no further shift under § 193 BGB. The Widerspruch must reach the Bezirksamt by this date.

warnings: The deadline calculation assumes the letter was actually posted on its printed date (19.11.2026); if postal dispatch happened later, the four-day delivery fiction and the one-month deadline shift accordingly.
The letter mentions a possible informal new application for a single table against the house wall, but gives no date or deadline for this - it is not a dated obligation and was not added as an item.
